$item_hardrock_knowledge1: Fear not death, for the hour of your doom is set, and no man can escape it.
$item_hardrock_knowledge10: You can keep as quiet as you like, but one day, someone will find you.
$item_hardrock_knowledge11: No matter how much suffering you went through, you never want to let go of those memories.
$item_hardrock_knowledge12: When you come out of the storm, you won’t be the same person who walked in. That’s what the storm is all about.
$item_hardrock_knowledge13: A rock feels no pain, and an island never cries.
$item_hardrock_knowledge2: Better to fight and fall than to live without hope.
$item_hardrock_knowledge3: Runes shall you find, and rightly read, of wondrous weight and mighty magic.
$item_hardrock_knowledge4: Man cannot discover new oceans unless he has the courage to lose sight of the shore.
$item_hardrock_knowledge5: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
$item_hardrock_knowledge6: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
$item_hardrock_knowledge7: We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
$item_hardrock_knowledge8: Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
$item_hardrock_knowledge9: Whatever it is you’re seeking won’t come in the form you’re expecting.
$item_trophy_abomination_lore: It's been dead so long that it started living again.
$item_trophy_asksvin_lore: A mighty beast, but now it shall roam no more.

$item_trophy_bjorn_lore: Mistakenly, it believed itself the master of the forest.
$item_trophy_bjorn_undead_lore: The most dreaded shadow of the night.

$item_trophy_blob_lava_lore: Even now, it's burning hot to the touch.

$item_trophy_brutebro_lore: The younger of two brothers. Jealous of his brother's magic.

$item_trophy_charredmelee_lore: Even in death, its gaze is unrelenting.

$item_trophy_cultist_lore: The fire in its eyes has still not burned out.
$item_trophy_deathsquito_lore: It's strange that we should suffer so much over so small a thing.
$item_trophy_deer_lore: Seemingly identical to the ones found in Midgard.

$item_trophy_draugr_lore: What should have been left to rest in peace has been awoken, twisted and corrupted.

$item_trophy_fenring_lore: Halfway between wolf and man, forever frozen in a snarl of pain.

$item_trophy_ghost_lore: There is still something haunting about its presence...

$item_trophy_mole_lore: This eyeless one shall dig no more.

$item_trophy_morgen_lore: Only the most twisted of minds could summon such a creature.
$item_trophy_neck_lore: These creatures thrive in water, until a viking lands on their shores.
$item_trophy_seal_lore: Those big, sad eyes stare back at you. What have you done?

$item_trophy_serpent_lore: It ruled the seas unchallenged – until now.
$item_trophy_sgolem_lore: Rock and crystal, brought to life by ancient magic.
$item_trophy_shamanbro_lore: The elder brother. Wished he had his brother's strength.

$item_trophy_surtling_lore: A fiendish creature, born of fire.
